_note: v4 rebuild. The seven new keys plus the two the panels overturned. FIVE INDEPENDENT PANELS found that the shipped hintTap was MATHEMATICALLY FALSE in every locale — it said the beads that LOOK alike move together, while the model moves the beads in the same PLACE in the unit (the congruence class mod k). With a unit of AABB those are different sets, and AABB is already a shipped printable (K-048). Worse, 'beads that look the same move together' is exactly the surface reading invention #1 exists to defeat. Every locale below names POSITION. printKey was 'Key'/'Clave' — which reads as ANSWER KEY on a worksheet, the one artefact this tool refuses; it is a legend everywhere now. Bracket nouns were re-chosen per locale after each panel found the obvious word already owned by comparison-planks (es corchete, it parentesi, pt colchete, nl beugel, fr accolade) — and nl 'de haak' was doubly wrong: a haak is a coat-hook, and the drawn object is the diminutive 'het haakje', which is also a GENDER change.

en.hintSlide: Move the bracket. The strip stays exactly the same.
